"''''Lagos'', you are clear to proceed.|''Lagos'' captain requests permission to communications ship|}} '''''Lagos''''' was a [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] used by the [[Galactic Empire]]. After the destruction of the [[Imperial Communications Center]] on [[Lothal]], ''Lagos'' was used to ferry [[R4 courier droid]]s to and from the ''[[Tellstar]]'' in order to maintain Imperial communications. ==History== After the rebel cell known as the [[Spectres]] [[Raid on the communications tower|took control]] of [[Lothal]]'s [[Imperial Communications Center]], [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] ordered the tower destroyed. Without the primary communications tower, the Empire started using [[R4 courier droid]]s to relay information to place to place, and [[shuttle]] ''Lagos'' was assigned to carry courier droids to the [[Arquitens-class light cruiser|communications ship]] ''[[Tellstar]]'' in orbit around the [[planet]]. When the rebels stole the courier droid [[264]], they sent their [[Droid|mechanic member]] [[C1-10P]] "Chopper" in its place aboard ''Lagos'' in an attempt to gain information about [[Kanan Jarrus]], their leader who had been [[Prisoner|captured]] during the raid on the communications tower. Unaware of the real courier's capture, the crew of ''Lagos'' delivered Chopper to the ''Tellstar'', which allowed the rebel droid to copy communication logs from it. ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Rebel Resolve}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{Databank|imperial-sentinel-class-shuttle|Imperial ''Sentinel''-Class Shuttle}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |pl=Lagos (prom) }} [[Category:Sentinel-class landing craft]] [[Category:Starships of the Galactic Empire]]
